cohort: 502 women who received a sonoEFW ≥4000 g within 2 weeks prior to delivery
finding: In patients undergoing sonoEFW within 2 weeks of delivery, sonoEFWs ≥4000 g are significantly more likely to overestimate than underestimate the true birth weight.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was performed in 32.1% of the cohort for suspected macrosomia.
birth_weight: Birth weight was measured at birth.
